title: Claude Skill Format
description: JSON Schema for Claude Code Skills - reusable patterns invoked during conversation

name.description: Skill identifier (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only)

description.description: Brief overview of functionality and when to use it

license.description: Optional license identifier for the skill (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0)

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated list of tools the skill is allowed to use (e.g., 'Read, Edit, Bash')

content.description: Markdown content with instructions and examples

frontmatter.name: refactor-helper
frontmatter.description: Assists with code refactoring while maintaining functionality

examples.content:
# Refactor Helper Skill

Helps refactor code while maintaining functionality.

## Guidelines

- Preserve existing behavior
- Improve code structure and readability
